About ACME Solutions

We started this because we'd lived the pain.

ACME Solutions was founded by operators who spent a decade running operations at companies that grew faster than their systems. We're building the platform we wish we'd had.

Mission

To give every operations team — not just the ones at trillion-dollar companies — access to the infrastructure that makes work feel coherent instead of chaotic.

Vision

A world where the size of your finance team doesn't determine whether your numbers reconcile, and where running a business doesn't require duct-taping fourteen tools together at 11pm.

Our story

Six years, three offices, no funding round we regret.

2020

Founded in a garage in Brno

Three engineers, one ex-COO, a whiteboard covered in process diagrams, and the conviction that mid-market operations didn't have to be this hard.

2021

First ten paying customers

Logistics, light manufacturing, professional services. We learned more in those ten implementations than in the prior decade combined.

2023

SOC 2 Type II, expansion to 4 countries

Compliance milestones unlocked the regulated verticals — banking, healthcare, energy. Headcount tripled. We learned how to hire well, mostly by hiring badly first.

2025

240+ live deployments, 92% retention

Our customers stay. The product gets used. The unit economics work. We crossed profitability six months ahead of plan.

2026

Launching ACME Insight

Our newest product line — operational analytics built on the same platform our customers already trust. The full suite, finally.

Leadership

The people steering this thing.

Operators, engineers, and one accidental philosopher. We've been the customer; that's the bias we bring to the work.

What we believe

Five principles we won't compromise on.

Boring is a feature.

Operations infrastructure should be predictable. We optimize for fewer surprises, not more demos.

Customers, not users.

If we don't know your name, your team, and what you're trying to ship this quarter, we haven't done our job.

Audit trails are sacred.

Every action, every change, every export — logged, attributable, reversible. No exceptions, no quick fixes.

We say no.

To the wrong customer, the wrong feature, the wrong shortcut. Discipline at the front end is mercy at the back end.

Compounding wins.

Small improvements, shipped weekly, beat heroic rewrites every time. Our roadmap reflects this. So does our hiring.

Want to work with us — or for us?

We're hiring across engineering, customer success, and operations. We're also always open to a conversation with new customers.
